name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
label: Quest
description: The Flesh Does Not Lie: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Forsaken apothecaries are not the only beings in this world schooled in the sciences.

I have been studying the plague for years, traveler. We had previously thought that the potency of the plague was dwindling, but what I have discovered here in the Plaguelands is startling. The plague seems to be growing in strength!
I need to run more tests! The most potent source of the plague is from the tainted flesh of the most recently infected. Travel to Stratholme and bring me samples, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Some say I worry too much - to them I say, 'You don't worry enough!'

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is something that has changed in the chemical structure of the plague's active agents. More data is required.
